summary: Embraer S.A. filed a Form 6-K containing a call notice for an Extraordinary General Shareholders Meeting to be held October 30, 2026, exclusively digitally via Microsoft Teams. The agenda covers approval of the Protocol and Justification for the merger of wholly owned subsidiary Embraer GPX Ltda. into Embraer, ratification of Forvis Mazars as appraisal firm, approval of the appraisal report of GPX net equity as of June 30, 2026, and approval of the merger effective October 31, 2026. This is an intra-group upstream merger of a subsidiary, a routine corporate reorganization rather than a third-party special situation; no price, premium, or advisors are disclosed, with Forvis Mazars named solely as appraiser. What to watch: shareholder approval and any dissent/appraisal rights under Brazilian Corporation Law, though the subsidiary merger implies minimal deal risk.
